recipes.title: Honey Garlic Beef (10 meal-prep servings)

items.i: trimmed flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Toss the sliced flank steak with the cornstarch, soy sauce, olive oil, garlic powder, pepper and salt.
Sear the beef in batches in a very hot pan or wok until browned at the edges; don't crowd the pan.
In the pan, simmer the honey, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar blend, garlic, ginger, hoisin and chili flakes until glossy. Thicken with the cornstarch slurry if needed.
Return the beef and toss until coated and the sauce clings.
Divide into 10 containers over rice and top with sesame seeds and green onions.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros are the creator's, per serving without rice. His caption doesn't spell out the cooking steps, so the method is the standard one for this dish.
